name: Product and feature intake
userOutcome: The user can describe a product goal or feature, constraints, target platforms, and success criteria as a durable planning request.
productionDataSource: User input and selected project context stored in SQLite.
errorBehavior: Preserve the draft, show field-specific validation, and never start paid or external planning until the request is saved and authorized.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not fabricate requirements the user did not approve.
Do not discard drafts after failure.
Do not start planning from invalid input.
acceptanceTests: Cancel without losing a saved draft.
Start planning from an approved request.
